title: Senior Marketing Manager - Consumer
description: Senior Marketing Manager - Consumer About the team SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate. More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world's largest consumer financial ecosystems. Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers, and this role will lead that journey. This role sits at the heart of that growth. As Senior Marketing Manager (Merchant to Consumer) , you'll drive the merchant-to-consumer acquisition engine: the channel that converts SumUp's merchant network and their customers into SumUp personal banking customers. This is a rare chance to build a differentiated acquisition channel from scratch inside a small, ambitious team, competing head-to-head with some of the best-funded neobanks in Europe. What you'll do Plan and execute merchant-to-consumer acquisition campaigns across six markets — owning messaging, creative strategy, localisation, and performance reporting Embed consumer sign-up moments into merchant touchpoints, including the super app, card readers, merchant CRM, and merchant website Drive cross-sell from SumUp Local into the consumer banking app, managing conversion, activation, and incentives for consumers coming through merchant-led channels Work closely with teams across Hardware, CRM, and other business lines to get consumer acquisition placements shipped through channels you don't directly own Build and maintain reporting on merchant-to-consumer acquisition performance, using it to inform channel-mix decisions and prove cost-per-customer against direct advertising You'll be great for this role if… Strong B2C growth or lifecycle marketing experience, ideally in fintech, payments, retail, or a marketplace Proven track record of planning and executing campaigns across multiple markets, including localisation and creative direction Experience marketing through partner or owned channels, such as CRM, in-product surfaces, or point-of-sale, rather than relying solely on paid media Comfort owning acquisition metrics, attribution, and reporting end to end, with a data-driven and commercially minded approach Ability to influence and coordinate across matrixed teams to get placements and campaigns shipped without direct authority Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. title: Director of Product, Workflows
description: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies. We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles. We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together! Director of Product, Workflows CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies run their creator marketing programs on. A large customer works with thousands of creators a year across dozens of programs and several markets, and every one of those partnerships has to be sourced, vetted, agreed, briefed, tracked and paid for. You'll own that operational core and lead the product teams that cover it today, accountable for making the whole thing feel like one operation instead of a series of handoffs. The mandate is to rebuild that operation around AI. Tooling in this category, ours included, was designed for a world where a person did each step by hand, and it still assumes that. It scales by adding people. A community manager keeping a 2,000-creator program on track lives in spreadsheets. An agency casting 300 creators against a brief in a week gets there by throwing bodies at it. Your job is to change what the software is responsible for, so programs scale without the headcount and the people running them spend their time on decisions that need judgment. In this role, you’ll get to: Own the workflow end to end. Discovery, Lists, Community, Campaigns and Messaging are one continuous job for our customers, and today they feel like separate products. Making them one, and making most of it happen without a human clicking through it, is the mandate. Lead and grow a team of product managers. You'll set the bar for how they work, coach them on discovery and judgment, and give them enough room to own their surfaces without you in the middle of every decision. Decide what gets rebuilt agentically, what gets simplified, and what gets deleted. Plenty of our existing workflow exists because someone needed a manual solution in 2020. Some of it should be automated, some should be replaced by a better model of the problem, and some should just go away. Get the trust model right. Provenance, confidence, human-in-the-loop review, honest failure, and clean rollback are what decide whether an enterprise customer lets an agent touch a live campaign. Partner with engineering and design leadership on architecture and delivery. Schema, core service, bulk operations, permissions, the data model that both the UI and the agents read from. You need to be credible in those conversations, not just present for them. Who you are and what you’ll need for this position: You've spent 8+ years in product, including 2+ leading product managers. Titles matter less than the work, but we need someone who has managed PMs before and knows the difference between coaching and taking over. You've owned a broad, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS surface where the product is the customer's daily job. You have a builder's mindset and haven't stopped being hands-on. You prototype. You use AI tools to build the thing rather than write a doc about the thing, and you expect the same from your team. You've rebuilt a manual workflow around AI and know the difference between removing the work and putting a chat box in front of the same twelve clicks. You're fluent in the mechanics too: retrieval, tool use, evaluation, human-in-the-loop review, and where an agent shouldn't be allowed to act alone. You have real product taste and you use it on AI output. You can look at an agent's plan, a generated brief, or a search result and say why it's good or why it's plausible-sounding filler. You ask the same question of a big customer's request or an inherited roadmap item: does this actually solve the problem? You're technical enough to hold your own on data model and API design. Schemas, CRUDL, bulk operations, permissions, third-party integrations. You can tell when a small-sounding request is touching something structural. You can prioritize across teams with genuinely competing claims and explain the tradeoff so the people who lost the argument still understand it. You write well. Most of how we work is async and in docs, and a Director who can only communicate in meetings will not scale here. You take initiative and own outcomes. You don't wait to be told the priority, and you'd rather bring a proposal than a list of questions. You're curious, self-driven, low-ego, and allergic to "that's not my job." Comfortable working with distributed teams across time zones. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Nice to have Experience with influencer marketing, creator workflows, or martech. Experience building search, discovery, or recommendation products, including semantic or multimodal search. Experience shipping CRM, relationship management, or lifecycle products. Experience shipping AI features into enterprise accounts where governance, auditability and permissions were part of the deal. Experience hiring product managers and building a team from a partial bench. Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow. What you will get from us: People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us. Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave. Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits. Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead. Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program. Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you. Who we are: CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram . At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry. Compensation, Benefits and Beyond: We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks . AI Transparency Notice We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice . Compensation: £110K – £143K • Offers Equity • £110K – £143K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As an Account Executive at Scarlet you will own deals from discovery to close by building relationships with regulatory and operations leaders. You will become a regulatory expert capable of meeting the complex needs of our customers. Your work will help ambitious medical technology companies bring safe products to patients sooner and drive Scarlet’s growth. This is a London-based role with a global reach. What you'll be working on The companies you'll be selling to are doing some of the most interesting work in healthcare right now. Your job is to find the next Floy or Skin Analytics and show them there's a faster way. Responsibilities Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers at cutting-edge technology companies across the healthcare industry, in person wherever possible, including at major industry conferences (e.g. MEDICA in Düsseldorf, RSNA in Chicago) and customer sites globally Source, own, and win deals from discovery to closed won with the right customers Collaborate closely with teammates to bring the relevant expertise to different parts of the sales motion and communicate Scarlet’s value proposition Work with the rest of the Sales function to continuously improve our processes Drive continuous iteration by sharing insights from customer interactions to help shape our go-to-market strategy and product offering Required qualifications You have 2-3 years of B2B commercial experience You’re insatiably curious about the world and what makes people tick You have a high EQ, which alongside your curiosity enables you to navigate complex human relationships, understand people’s drivers, communicate creatively, and close complex deals You have exceptional written & verbal communication skills You are a self-starter, high-agency, and take ownership of your own success Preferred qualifications You have experience working in healthcare and/or a regulated industry Interview process We typically collapse interviews 3 to 6 into one in-person session Intro call with Karan - 20 mins Interview with Val or Anna - 30 mins Live case with Dan - 30 mins Interview with James - 30 mins Interview with Jamie - 30 mins Interview with James A - 30 mins Referencing Offer Compensation: £150K – £190K • Offers Equity • The range provided is the total cash compensation, meaning it includes both the base salary and sales commissions/bonuses. £150K – £190K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Branch Merchandiser
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Branch Merchandiser will play a critical role in setting the branch merchandising strategy across retail stores and international locations.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>This is a newly created role that offers the opportunity to set the branch merchandising strategy and ownership structures across retail stores in the UK with scope to expand across additional international locations. The successful candidate will evolve and streamline the existing critical path — currently spread across multiple teams — into a cohesive approach to range planning, space planning, and allocation strategy, establishing clear processes across commercial functions. The Senior Branch Merchandiser delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Team & Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally with Retail, Buying & Merchandising, Logistics, and Finance teams to ensure alignment and delivery against commercial objectives.</li> <li>Partner with supply chain and logistics to forecast short-term retail dispatch and DC volumes, and to determine the best delivery day, method, and frequency for each store.</li> <li>Gain buy-in at Senior Management level through excellent communication and influencing skills, presenting data-backed strategies and recommendations with confidence and clarity.</li> <li>Define the ownership structure and clear processes across the commercial functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fan & Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Deliver an optimised, balanced range for retail that meets and exceeds sales and margin targets, ensuring fans in every store have access to the right product at the right time.</li> <li>Conduct regular store visits to gather market intelligence and competitor analysis, translating insights into actionable range and space recommendations that elevate the in-store fan experience</li> <li>Partner with Heads of Retail and General Managers to identify existing and new commercial opportunities that drive availability and satisfaction across all store grades.</li> <li>Feedback market intelligence and analysis to Buying & Merchandising teams to inform future ranging decisions and strengthen the end-to-end fan offer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Trial and propose new ideas to move the business forward, including evolving allocation and replenishment systems for greater efficiency and accuracy.</li> <li>Manage specific projects end-to-end — documenting and analysing information, formulating conclusions, and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Potentialise sales and profit opportunities by store grade, using commercial analysis and data to unlock performance improvements across the estate.</li> <li>Develop and implement best practice distribution methods in partnership with merchandising and supply chain teams, optimising delivery frequency and stock flow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ownership & Execution</strong> (Determined & Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Set commercial initial allocations by category aligned with planned store turnover, space, and cover, and implement and manage the seasonal allocation and replenishment strategy by department and category.</li> <li>Analyse and review weekly, monthly, and seasonal trade by store and grade versus budget and prior year, proposing short, medium, and longer-term corrective actions with pace and precision.</li> <li>Manage store openings, modernisations, closures, and space changes in close collaboration with Buying & Merchandising teams to deliver successful launches on time and on brief.</li> <li>Oversee the smooth flow of stock across stores, maximising potential through initial allocation, re-assortments, and end-of-season stock removal to Outlet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in a fast-paced Retail Merchandising or Space Planning role, ideally within a multi-site High Street or omnichannel retail environment.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen with a deep understanding of store grading, range optimisation, space planning, and allocation and replenishment strategy.</li> <li>Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex trading data and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively at all levels, including gaining buy-in from Senior Management on strategic decisions.</li> <li>Experience managing store openings, closures, or estate changes in collaboration with buying, merchandising, and logistics functions.</li> <li>A collaborative, cross-functional working style with the ability to build effective relationships across retail, B&M, logistics, and finance teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and a solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure and deliver to deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Manchester, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence <strong>3 days per week.</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Contracts Manager
description: <p>Senior Contracts Manager</p> <p>Location – UK - Windsor/ Edinburgh / Ireland - Dublin  </p> <p>Type of Work - Office</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Role Overview</u></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Contracts Manager to join the UKI Legal team. The role will support business growth and financial objectives by managing legal and commercial risk and enabling effective delivery of software and services to the NHS, and other UK & Ireland (UKI) healthcare and non-healthcare customers.</p> <p>The Senior Contracts Manager will play a key role in managing contracts across their full lifecycle, working closely with the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams to ensure contractual arrangements align with business objectives, governance requirements and public sector procurement norms.</p> <p>As the senior contracts role in the UKI Legal team, the Senior Contracts Manager will generally be assigned the most complex, high-value and strategically significant matters. They must also operate with substantial autonomy within an agreed mandate, and help set standards, draft regional and global processes, and develop capability across the contracts function.</p> <p>This role will be based in either InterSystems’ Windsor, Edinburgh, or Dublin offices and may require occasional domestic and international travel. Office location will be determined based on the successful candidate’s location. An office location that is not Windsor will require periodic attendance at the Windsor office.</p> <p><strong><u>Key Responsibilities </u></strong><strong>– The role encompasses end-to-end contract lifecycle management, including pre-contract support, post-contract management, and risk and governance oversight.</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Pre-Contract Activities</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead legal team input into assigned tender and bid responses, particularly for NHS and other public sector procurements.</li> <li>Draft, review and negotiate a range of customer and supplier contracts, ensuring alignment with business objectives, legal and commercial risk appetite, and applicable NHS and public sector requirements.</li> <li>Provide pragmatic and commercially focused contractual advice to support sales and project mobilisation activities.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Post-Contract Management</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Take named, end-to-end ownership of a defined portfolio of client contracts, including high-value and complex contracts, holding accountability for commercial outcomes across the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Manage contracts following signature, including business adherence to contractual obligations, change control processes and contract variations.</li> <li>Support the delivery and operations teams in the practical application and management of contractual obligations throughout the contract lifecycle.</li> <li>Monitor contractual performance, compliance and key post-signature obligations.</li> <li>Support the management of third-party vendors/sub-contractors and suppliers, both local and global, as required.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Risk and Governance</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the implementation, day-to-day governance, administration and continuous improvement of regional and global AI-enabled legal support technologies, ensuring effective, compliant and business-aligned usage across the legal function.</li> <li>Identify, assess and escalate legal and commercial risks to appropriate internal stakeholders and, where necessary, internal or external legal counsel.</li> <li>Implement and ensure adherence to internal contract management and governance processes.</li> <li>Manage ambiguity and develop practical, proportionate solutions to contractual and risk management challenges.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Stakeholder Engagement</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide clear, practical guidance on contractual matters to colleagues at all levels, including the Legal, Sales, Delivery and Leadership teams.</li> <li>Mentor and develop contract managers and other colleagues, setting standards and sharing best contract management practice across the global legal team.</li> <li>Coordinate with local and international colleagues to resolve contractual issues efficiently.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Experience/Qualification Required </u></strong></p> <ul> <li>A minimum of 7-9 years proven, hands-on experience in high-value contract management, ideally within healthcare, IT, and/or the public sector. As a guide to applicants, evidence of a directly accountable portfolio TCV over £100M is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of operating with autonomy on high-value, complex and strategically significant contracts, and of leading negotiations through to conclusion.</li> <li>Strong drafting, negotiation and analytical skills, with a pragmatic and commercially focused approach.</li> <li>Comfortable working with digital workflow tools, document automation systems, and AI enabled legal support technologies to improve contract review speed, accuracy, consistency, and compliance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of legal operations processes, contract lifecycle management platforms and AI-enabled legal technologies is highly desirable.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience of using UKI model form contracts and frameworks, with an understanding of government and NHS procurement laws and public sector contracting norms.</li> <li>Ability to identify, define and articulate key commercial principles to support sound legal and business outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain complex contractual issues to non-specialists.</li> <li>Sound judgment, strong organisational skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Degree and/or postgraduate qualifications with a legal or commercial focus are preferred; relevant professional qualifications are welcomed.</li> <li>Experience with AI-related regulatory environments such as the EU AI Act is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About InterSystems</strong></p> <p style="font-weight: 400;">InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit <a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https://www.intersystems.com/&esheet=53379223&newsitemid=20230410005415&lan=en-US&anchor=InterSystems.com&index=4&md5=3edf749fa33f5a2ac0c355c410576e90" data-outlook-id="1e721f69-f681-4067-9281-970e94b3ef11"><strong>InterSystems.com</strong></a>.</p> <p style="font-weight: 400;"> </p> <p style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>AI Disclaimer</strong></p> <p>InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information).  InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the <a href="https://www.intersystems.com/ai-use-guidelines/">InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines</a>. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.</p> <p>Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience.  AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.</p> <p>Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><em>strictly prohibited</em><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.  Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><em>prior</em> to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p>CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. </p> <p>CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit <a href="https://www.chaosinc.com">www.chaosinc.com</a>.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>You’ll join a small, highly collaborative team working across London and San Francisco, building the software behind some of the world’s most advanced radar systems.</p> <p>Working alongside software, hardware, and systems engineers, and the teams who take these systems into the field, you’ll design the backend services, data pipelines, and operator-facing applications that turn raw sensor data into decisions people can act on.</p> <p>The systems you build must be reliable, resilient, secure, and performant - enabling operators to depend on them in the environments where they matter most.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership role where you’ll influence architecture and help define the engineering foundations of a rapidly evolving platform. We’re looking for engineers who enjoy scaling distributed systems and solving hard data problems.</p> <h2>What You’ll Build</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend Services</strong> - develop high-performance Python services that ingest, process, and distribute real-time sensor data with low latency, high reliability, and security at scale.</li> <li><strong>Operator Interfaces</strong> - build and evolve the web applications operators use to monitor live missions and investigate what the sensors saw (TypeScript and React).</li> <li><strong>Cloud Platform</strong> - design and build secure, scalable Azure services that power distributed radar systems, defining the infrastructure as code and instrumentation for the systems you own.</li> <li><strong>Platform Architecture</strong> - help shape the technical direction of the platform, making architectural decisions that support new capabilities, increasing scale, and long-term maintainability.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>We’re looking for exceptional software engineers who are excited by solving hard technical problems and building systems that matter. You don’t need experience with every technology we use - we value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly.</p> <p>You’ll thrive in this role if you:</p> <ul> <li>Enjoy building scalable backend systems and taking ownership of production services.</li> <li>Enjoy solving complex distributed systems and real-time data challenges.</li> <li>Are eager to learn new technologies and adapt to new technical domains.</li> <li>Care deeply about reliability, security, and scalability.</li> <li>Get real leverage from AI coding tools, with a considered view on what to delegate to them and what not to.</li> <li>Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams.</li> <li>Are motivated by building technology with meaningful real-world impact.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Right to work in the UK.</strong></li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel.</strong> You’ll be based in our Soho office in London, but most of the team is in San Francisco - expect to co-locate there for around a week each quarter.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Why CHAOS?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Health Benefits:</strong> private medical, dental and vision benefits (for employees & dependents) will be 100% paid for by the company</li> <li><strong>Additional benefits</strong>: 5% pension match</li> <li><strong>Compensation Components:</strong> competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance + (coming soon!) annual bonuses</li> <li><strong>Team Growth: </strong>350 employees and counting across 5 global offices</li> </ul> <div> </div> <p><em>The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. </em></p> <hr> <h3>Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.</h3> <hr> <p><em>#LI-onsite</em></p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

critical services.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Required qualities and skills:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform, infrastructure, or software engineering role, <li>Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc).</li> <li>Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly Terraform.</li> <li>Experience working with a major cloud platform (Azure, GCP, AWS).</li> <li>Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, load balancing, firewalls).</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues to colleagues from non-technical teams.</li> <li>Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell, or Bash.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows Server administration.</li> <li>Experience with monitoring and observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, or Sentry.</li> <li>Some SQL and exposure to relational databases, particularly SQL title: Content Operations Associate
description: Hi 👋 I'm Deyan, Director of Corporate Marketing at hyperexponential. I lead Corporate Marketing: brand creative and design, PR and communications, flagship events, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. A podcast episode or a report becomes clips, articles, exec posts, and social across everything the department touches. I'm hiring a Content Operations Associate to help turn that into a repeatable operation. title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Userlane Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally. Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications. Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't. You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?" You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does. Healthcare experience is a strong plus You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike You're fluent in English (spoken and written) What's in for you Team & Culture : A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems Product strategy influence : Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors Market : Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry Growth : We take you and your development seriously. title: Platform Engineer
description: About us We love pets - which is why we're on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents. We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We've helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day. Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing. Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things. Want to join our pack? Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets. A day in the life As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on. This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets. Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration. We embrace modern development practices: All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience. We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day. We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start. As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on. Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable. Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it. Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services. Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads. ü Make our security controls provable Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements. Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort. Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved. Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling. ü Strengthen access and identity controls Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege. Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities. Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review. ü Extend our platform standards beyond AWS Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate. Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are. ü Team collaboration Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions. Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously. Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews. Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance. ü Self development Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan. Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset. Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship. Your skills and experience We are looking for someone with: Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure). Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar. Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines. A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption. Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python. Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously. We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other: A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation. Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud. The interview process This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom. Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team. Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need. Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise. Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security. About the team The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about. Our tech stack We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn. You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas. Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics. To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean. We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding. We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices. We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud. Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare Salary range: £55,000 — £65,000 GBP Ways of working On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset. You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day. We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively. We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support. Inclusion at ManyPets We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won't discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback. If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. Reasonable adjustments and support If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email Connect with us! title: Product Engineer (Senior)
description: 📍London/ Hybrid £80,000 - £115,000 + £30,000 share options + Benefits 💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. The team Our engineers have sat in GP waiting rooms. They've watched practice managers juggle three systems at once to send a single message to a patient. They build for that person. What sets our Product Engineers apart is that they own the problem, not just the code. They shape what gets built and how - working with Product, Design and Clinical from the earliest stages - and they stay with the systems they build as they evolve. They bring engineering judgment into product decisions, and product thinking into engineering ones. Our stack is primarily C# on the backend, TypeScript and React on the frontend, running on Azure. ML/AI work uses Python. We don't expect you to know all of it - we expect you to follow a problem wherever it leads. What you'll be doing Owning features end-to-end: from refining the problem with clinicians and product managers through to architecture, implementation, rollout, and long-term evolution Engaging directly with NHS GPs, practice staff and patients to build a genuine understanding of the problems you're solving — research sessions, visiting practices Designing architecture and API boundaries with the broader system in mind, not just the immediate surface Holding the quality bar for what you ship: not just that the code works, but that the product is reliable, intuitive and safe in a clinical context Making the architectural calls that keep our codebase sustainable — improving system health alongside shipping features, not instead of it Pushing back constructively when something is wrong, and committing fully when a decision has been made What experience you need to be successful Comfortable building production software across the stack - you might be strongest in backend or frontend, but you can follow a problem across both to own a feature end-to-end Proven ability to reason about systems - breaking ambiguous problems into tractable pieces, spotting trade-offs and second-order effects before they become incidents Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage problem definition; you shape the work rather than wait for a finished spec You treat engineering quality as part of the job - managing technical debt pragmatically, reviewing AI-generated output critically, and pushing for the right architectural decisions under real constraints Curiosity about AI tools and how they change the way you work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when not to What we’re looking for to demonstrate as a Product Engineer at Accurx You start from the user problem, not the technology. You know what to build, what not to build, and why. In the AI era, that also means knowing what to delegate, what needs human judgment, and what shouldn't exist at all. You can break ambiguous problems into tractable pieces and see how those pieces connect across boundaries. You spot seams, trade-offs, and second-order effects — thinking both from big to small and small to big. You can pick up unfamiliar code, systems, and assess AI-generated output. You spot flaws before being told, and you understand why something is wrong. You have strong expertise in at least one area and can use it to build, debug, and improve real systems effectively. You know what “great” looks like in your domain and can reliably get there. You own outcomes, not just tasks. You influence across teams, navigate disagreement to reach the right answer, own your mistakes, and push hard for the wins that matter. You actively experiment with AI tools to push the boundaries of what's possible today, with the scepticism to avoid overhyping what they can do. You're actively learning and experimenting with AI tools, pushing the boundary of what's possible today, with the healthy scepticism that keeps you from overhyping what they can do. What’s in it for me? You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to fix healthcare communication. £80,000 - £115,000 salary + £30,000 share options Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life Flexible working: We are an office-first,, culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat! title: Software Engineer - Distributed Compute
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is one of the top algorithmic trading companies in the world. Our research cluster is the backbone of our success; it’s where all of our trading strategies are generated.</p> <p>We use a large, customized research environment with highly advanced CPU and GPU compute, storage, and networking technology. Our team thinks about the entire software stack, from the user-level API to optimizing performance out of low-level caching. We deal with everything from the theoretical, like fair resource scheduling, to the concrete, like optimizing a trader’s new program run-time performance. </p> <p>As a distributed compute engineer in a user-facing environment, you’ll develop and improve on technical solutions that make research as easy and efficient as possible. title: ASO & Partnerships Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Level Up Your Career with Zynga!</strong></p> <p>At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.</p> <p>From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!</p> <p>Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the play!</p></div><p>We are looking for an ASO & Partnerships leader to drive organic growth and deepen platform relationships for Merge Dragons, Monster Legends, Dragon City, FarmVille titles and many more. This role owns the studio's app store optimization strategy end-to-end and serves as our primary relationship holder with the major app store platforms — Google Play, the Apple App Store, Microsoft Store and Amazon Appstore.</p> <p>You will lead a team responsible for improving organic visibility, store conversion, and featuring, while working closely with Product, Creative, UA, and Data teams to unlock sustainable organic growth and strengthen the top of the funnel. You will mentor and empower the ASO team to deliver best-in-class execution, and you'll be the studio's trusted voice in front of our platform partners.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em>Strategic Leadership</em></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end ASO strategy for the portfolio, driving organic installs, store conversion, and keyword/category rankings across all markets.</li> <li>Define and manage the yearly organic growth roadmap, including localization, seasonal, and launch strategies.</li> <li>Set the studio's platform partnership strategy, aligning featuring and promotional opportunities with business priorities and release calendars.</li> </ul> <p><em>Platform Partnerships</em></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain strategic relationships with Google Play, Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, and Amazon Appstore partner teams.</li> <li>Secure featuring, editorial placements, and promotional opportunities across launches, updates, and key seasonal moments.</li> <li>Advocate for early access to platform betas, new store features, monetization tools, and APIs, and channel those opportunities back to Product and UA.</li> <li>Represent the studio in partner reviews, QBRs, and industry events, and negotiate co-marketing and joint business plans.</li> </ul> <p><em>Performance Optimization</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead store listing experimentation (Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, Google Play store listing experiments) to improve conversion rate.</li> <li>Own keyword and metadata optimization, and build rigorous test roadmaps across icons, screenshots, preview videos, and descriptions.</li> <li>Establish measurement frameworks to attribute organic uplift and quantify the impact of ASO and featuring initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><em>Team & Collaboration</em></p> <ul> <li>Mentor ASO managers, specialists, and analysts; build structured career growth and execution excellence.</li> <li>Partner closely with Creative teams to fuel store asset testing velocity and creative breakthroughs.</li> <li>Collaborate with UA, Product, and Data teams to ensure cohesive full-funnel optimization and visibility improvements.</li> </ul> <p><em>Operational Excellence</em></p> <ul> <li>Establish clear accountability for results with transparent reporting and actionable insights.</li> <li>Improve execution speed through better process, prioritization, and cross-team alignment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>6–10+ years of ASO or mobile organic growth experience in free-to-play, ideally in gaming.</li> <li>Proven track record of improving organic installs and store conversion at scale across multiple markets.</li> <li>Established working relationships with platform partner teams (Apple, Google, and ideally Microsoft and/or Amazon).</li> <li>Strong fluency in ASO tools (e.g. AppTweak, Sensor Tower, data.ai) and store listing A/B testing methodologies.</li> <li>Deep understanding of app store algorithms, ranking factors, and each platform's merchandising ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.</li> <li>Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple functions.</li> <li>Bonus: familiarity with Match-3/puzzle models and hybrid-casual or builder games.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization.  Employment with us is origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.</p> <p>As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at ----- to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.</p> <p>Please be aware that Zynga does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others.  Zynga also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel.  Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage.  Zynga’s  in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).  </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Transformation Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Dialpad</strong><strong><br></strong>Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Being a Dialer</strong></span><br><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. We seek individuals who embody our core traits:<strong> Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic</strong>.</span></p></div><p><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Your role<br></span></strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The primary purpose of our AI Transformation Architect team is to accelerate the adoption and realization of value from our AI platform by embedding within our most strategic customer accounts. Synthesize and deliver this critical, high-value signal directly back to our core Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap and accelerate feature development.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">AI Envisioning: Navigate complex enterprise infrastructure (cloud, on-prem, data pipelines) to scope integration feasibility. Proficiency in Python, Go, JS/TS plus hands‑on experience with LLM frameworks.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Unrivaled Business Acumen: The ability to simplify technical complexity and communicate clear trade-offs, value propositions, and project plans to both a core engineering team and a non-technical C-suite executive.</span></li> <li><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>When you join Exclaimer you will join a global award-winning SaaS provider with an exceptional revenue rate, ambitious growth plans, and an inclusive and outcomes-driven culture.</h3> <p>Exclaimer is a high-growth SaaS company with 300+ colleagues across the UK, US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. We promote a people-first culture built on fairness, inclusion, psychological safety, and continuous learning. As we evolve into a multi-channel platform for branded business communications, we offer employees the opportunity to shape the future of global communication—while growing their careers in a culture where curiosity, creativity, and accountability thrive.  </p> <h3>We’re officially Great Place To Work Certified™</h3> <p>Exclaimer has been recognised by Great Place To Work® for our culture of collaboration, trust, and growth. This certification reflects our commitment to creating an environment where every voice matters and people genuinely enjoy coming to work.  See our accreditations to learn more: <a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.co.uk/certified-company/1575695">Great Place to Work® UK </a><a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/104575695">| Great Place To Work® USA</a></p> <p> </p> <h3>About the opportunity 👇</h3></div><h3><strong>Senior Product Manager, PLG & Onboarding</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>Exclaimer is the leading email signature management vendor. Our product appeals to companies who need their employees’ emails to include disclaimers and signatures with consistent branding.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our product-led growth (PLG) motion, with a particular focus on the self-serve onboarding flow on www.exclaimer.com: the path a new user takes from signup through activation, to their first meaningful "aha" moment during a trial, to becoming a paying customer.</p> <p>You’ll be working closely with our Head of PLG, with whom you agree improvements to the onboarding flow. Your impact on activation and time-to-value translates directly into revenue, retention, and lower cost of acquisition.</p> <p>You'll sit at the intersection of product, design, data, growth marketing, and sales, and you'll be judged on outcomes - activation rate, time-to-value, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid - not just features shipped.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the self-serve funnel end to end</strong> – the initial focus is on signup, activation and first-value.</li> <li><strong>Redesign and continuously improve onboarding </strong>– make it really easy for new users to set up and deploy their first signature in an intuitive self-guided way that gets users to value fast.</li> <li><strong>Track funnel metrics</strong> - activation rate, time-to-value, trial/free-to-paid conversion - and set targets against them. The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services. Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners. We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers. PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days. The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us! The Impact You'll Have This role is about generating and closing new opportunities while playing a key role supporting the Sales Director in setting the strategic vision for the business - here are a few key expectations: Closing and launching enterprise customers: Work alongside the team Director in identifying, closing and onboarding new customers. Manage the back end of the process including Salesforce rigour and reporting, financial modeling, and garnering internal approvals. Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering. Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations.
